source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of writing files (PDF 62).

blocks.text: File mein likhne ke liye usay write mode ("w") mein kholein aur write() method istemal karein. Purane data ke baad aur data jorna ho to append mode ("a") istemal karein.

#    Writing to a file
with open("example.txt", "w") as file:
    file.write("As-Salaam-Alaikum, World!\n")
#    Appending to a file
with open("example.txt", "a") as file:
    file.write("Appending new line.\n")

items: "w" mode file ka purana content (andar likha data) mita kar naya likhta hai, yani overwrite karta hai (file na ho to bana deta hai).
"a" mode purana content rakh kar naya data aakhir mein jorta hai. \n ka matlab nayi line hai.

blocks.prompt: Dono blocks chalne ke baad example.txt mein kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Do lines: "As-Salaam-Alaikum, World!" aur "Appending new line."

blocks.text: Program pehle "w" mode se pehli line likhta hai, phir "a" mode se doosri line aakhir mein jorta hai aur file parh kar dikhata hai. Dono lines badal kar Run karein.

first_line = "As-Salaam-Alaikum, World!"
second_line = "Python is fun."
with open("example.txt", "w") as file:
    file.write(first_line + "\n")
with open("example.txt", "a") as file:
    file.write(second_line + "\n")
with open("example.txt", "r") as file:
    print(file.read())

items: "w": mita kar likho; "a": aakhir mein joro.
